query: What features can be extracted from a company's business description to predict its regional cluster?

per_column.name: desc_word_count
per_column.rationale: Generic length metric; weak but legitimate signal outside the focus, plausibly varies by regional writing norms.

per_column.name: desc_avg_word_length
per_column.rationale: Stylometric measure external to regional_cluster; low but non-zero potential signal.

per_column.name: desc_sentence_count
per_column.rationale: Structural text feature, independent of region; weak predictive value.

per_column.name: tech_density
per_column.rationale: Density of technical terms; different regional tech hubs may vary, a plausible external predictor.

per_column.name: primary_industry
per_column.rationale: Industry inferred from description; regional clusters are known to specialize by industry, strong external predictor with no leakage of region itself.

per_column.name: industry_tag_count
per_column.rationale: Count of industry tags; a legitimate description-derived feature that may correlate with region.

per_column.name: is_fintech
per_column.rationale: Industry indicator; certain regions concentrate fintech, meaningful external signal.

per_column.name: is_healthcare
per_column.rationale: Healthcare concentration varies regionally; valid predictor.

per_column.name: is_enterprise_sw
per_column.rationale: Enterprise-software focus differs across regional hubs; valid predictor.

per_column.name: is_consumer
per_column.rationale: Consumer orientation may vary by region; legitimate feature.

per_column.name: is_security
per_column.rationale: Security specialization clusters regionally; valid predictor.

per_column.name: is_ai_ml
per_column.rationale: AI/ML concentration is strongly regional; valid predictor.

per_column.name: is_hardware_iot
per_column.rationale: Hardware/IoT hubs are geographically concentrated; valid predictor.

per_column.name: is_education
per_column.rationale: Edtech clustering may correlate with region; valid weak predictor.

per_column.name: mentions_b2b
per_column.rationale: Business-model signal external to region; plausible mild predictor.

per_column.name: has_funding_language
per_column.rationale: Funding rhetoric may differ across startup ecosystems/regions; plausible predictor.

per_column.name: action_verb_score
per_column.rationale: Stylometric feature independent of region; weak external signal.

judge.rationale: All columns are derived from the business description and lie outside the regional_cluster focus; none restate or leak the geographic label (latitude/longitude/city define the target but were not duplicated here). The industry indicators (primary_industry and the is_* dummies, ai_ml, security, etc.) carry the strongest genuine signal because tech industries cluster geographically, giving a model real leverage. The stylometric/text-shape features (word count, avg word length, sentence count, action_verb_score) are generic and mostly noise, and the industry dummies are heavily redundant with primary_industry, so incremental value is limited. As a set they provide moderate predictive leverage.
